document_metadata.title: 23、INT: TENEMENT BUILDING--DAY
document_metadata.summary: Mookie delivers pizza, demands fair tip after climbing five flights, and receives only a dollar, which he reluctantly accepts before vowing retaliation.

entities.name: Mookie hikes up a flight of stairs with a pizza box
entities.description: Mookie climbs a staircase carrying a pizza box, briefly setting it down to rest before continuing.

entities.name: Mookie rests while carrying a pizza box
entities.description: Mookie pauses his ascent, placing the pizza box down and taking a breather on the staircase.

entities.description: After resting, Mookie picks up the pizza box and continues ascending the final flights of stairs.

entities.name: Mookie rings the doorbell
entities.description: Mookie presses the buzzer at a door to signal his arrival with the delivered pizza.

entities.description: A young Puerto Rican woman, Nilda, answers the door after Mookie rings the buzzer.

entities.name: Mookie hands over the pizza to Nilda
entities.description: Mookie delivers the pizza to Nilda, assuring her it is not cold.

entities.name: Nilda pays Mookie with crumpled bills
entities.description: Nilda gives Mookie a handful of singles to pay for the pizza, which appear disorganized and uncounted.

entities.name: Mookie blocks the door to count the payment
entities.description: When Nilda attempts to close the door, Mookie prevents it by placing his foot forward and insists on counting the money first.

entities.name: Mookie counts and straightens the payment
entities.description: Mookie organizes the crumpled bills and carefully counts them to verify the amount received.

entities.name: Mookie informs Nilda she is short on payment
entities.description: After counting, Mookie tells Nilda that while the twelve dollars for the pizza is correct, there is no additional tip included.

entities.name: Nilda claims she counted the full amount
entities.description: Nilda responds to Mookie's complaint by asserting that she personally counted out the full twelve dollars for the pizza.

document_metadata.title: 24、EXT: MOTHER SISTER'S STOOP--DAY
document_metadata.summary: On an extremely hot day, residents cope with the heat in various ways, from cold showers to avoiding cooking; a kid fries an egg on Sal's car, sparking a chase, as newspapers highlight the intense heatwave.

entities.name: Jade arrives late and sits down with Mother Sister on the stoop
entities.description: Jade joins Mother Sister on the stoop after arriving late, initiating a conversation and reconnecting after not having a proper sit-down in a long time.

entities.name: Mother Sister hands Jade a bag from her side
entities.description: Mother Sister gives Jade a bag that had been sitting beside her on the stoop, transferring possession without explanation.

entities.name: Jade unwraps Mother Sister's head scarf to reveal long black hair
entities.description: Jade removes the head scarf covering Mother Sister's hair, allowing her long black hair to fall free as part of a grooming ritual.

entities.name: Jade begins parting, greasing, and combing Mother Sister's hair
entities.description: Jade starts the careful process of styling Mother Sister's hair, occasionally tugging too hard and causing discomfort.

entities.name: Mother Sister complains about Jade pulling her hair too hard
entities.description: Mother Sister reacts with pain when the comb catches in her hair and reminds Jade to be gentle due to her tender head.

entities.name: Da Mayor approaches and compliments Mother Sister's hair
entities.description: Da Mayor stops by the stoop, smiles, and tells Mother Sister that he didn't know she had such beautiful hair.

entities.name: Mother Sister dismisses Da Mayor with a sharp remark
entities.description: Mother Sister responds sarcastically to Da Mayor's compliment, implying he lacks knowledge about many things, including her.

entities.name: Da Mayor tips his hat and continues walking up the block
entities.description: After a brief exchange, Da Mayor signals his departure by tipping his hat and resumes his journey up the street.

entities.name: Jade criticizes Mother Sister for being cruel to Da Mayor
entities.description: Jade expresses disapproval of Mother Sister's harsh treatment of Da Mayor, suggesting it is unjustified and unkind.

entities.name: Mother Sister compares Da Mayor to her ex-husband and difficult tenants
entities.description: Mother Sister explains that Da Mayor reminds her of two groups she dislikes: her unreliable tenants and her ex-husband, whom she curses and blesses simultaneously.

entities.name: Mother Sister shares her frustration about late-paying tenants
entities.description: Mother Sister vents about having 'jive, laterent-paying trifling Negroes' as tenants and her recurring threat to sell the house.

entities.name: Mother Sister reveals her financial loss due to her ex-husband's failed business scheme
entities.description: Mother Sister recounts how her ex-husband lost all her property and money in an unsuccessful attempt to build a Black business empire, leaving her with only the current house.

entities.name: Jade and Mother Sister look up at the intense sun together
entities.description: Both Jade and Mother Sister pause their conversation to glance at the blazing sun overhead, silently acknowledging the oppressive heat.

entities.name: Clifton accidentally bumps into Buggin' Out and steps on his new sneakers
entities.description: While walking down the block, Clifton, a yuppie, collides with Buggin' Out, stepping on his newly purchased white Air Jordans and leaving a visible black smudge on them.

entities.name: Crowd gathers and reacts to the escalating argument
entities.description: The verbal conflict between Buggin' Out and Clifton draws a crowd of onlookers, including Ahmad, Cee, Punchy, and Ella, who react with laughter and encouragement toward Buggin' Out's remarks.

document_metadata.title: 34、INT: SAL'S FAMOUS PIZZERIA--DAY
document_metadata.summary: Mookie and Vito arrive at the shop; Pino mocks Mookie, hits Vito, and challenges him to retaliate, but Vito walks away, disappointing Mookie and satisfying Pino.

entities.description: In the midst of an argument, Pino physically strikes Vito, escalating tensions among the group present in the shop.

entities.description: After Pino hits Vito, Mookie tells Vito to fight back, challenging the power dynamic and family loyalty within the group.

entities.description: Faced with pressure to retaliate against his brother, Vito remains motionless and then leaves the scene, avoiding conflict.

document_metadata.title: 80、INT: SAL'S FAMOUS PIZZERIA--NIGHT
document_metadata.summary: Radio Raheem, enraged after Sal destroys his boombox, attacks and chokes Sal; Vito, Pino, and Buggin' Out intervene while others watch, escalating the confrontation.

entities.name: Mookie requests his pay from Sal before closing
entities.description: Mookie reminds Sal that it is almost quitting time and insists on being paid, expressing his need to receive his wages before leaving.

entities.name: Sal reflects on the success of the family-run pizzeria
entities.description: Sal looks into the cash register and comments on the good business they had, expressing pride in their family-run operation and envisioning a future where Vito, Pino, and Mookie take over.

entities.name: Vito, Pino, and Mookie react with horror to the idea of inheriting the pizzeria
entities.description: Upon hearing Sal's vision of the pizzeria becoming 'Sal's and Sons,' Vito, Pino, and Mookie exchange looks of dread, horrified at the prospect of being trapped working there for life.

entities.name: Ahmad, Cee, Punchy, and Ella enter the pizzeria requesting slices
entities.description: Ahmad, Cee, Punchy, and Ella enter the pizzeria just before closing and ask to buy four regular slices to go, prompting Sal to reluctantly agree as Mookie prepares their order.

entities.name: Mookie warns customers to leave promptly after receiving their food
entities.description: Mookie instructs Ahmad, Cee, Punchy, and Ella to take their slices and leave immediately, emphasizing that no loitering or playing around will be allowed as everyone wants to go home.

entities.name: Buggin' Out and Radio Raheem enter the pizzeria with loud music
entities.description: Buggin' Out and Radio Raheem enter the pizzeria while Radio Raheem's boombox blares rap music at an extremely high volume, forcing people to shout to be heard and disrupting the closing process.

entities.name: Sal confronts Buggin' Out about the noise from the boombox
entities.description: Sal angrily reminds Buggin' Out that he has previously forbidden loud music in the pizzeria, demanding that the noise stop immediately.

entities.name: Buggin' Out challenges Sal about the lack of Black representation on the Wall of Fame
entities.description: Buggin' Out counters Sal's noise complaint by demanding that Black people be included on the pizzeria's Wall of Fame, initiating a confrontation over racial representation.

entities.name: Sal insults Radio Raheem's music as jungle music
entities.description: Sal denigrates the rap music playing from Radio Raheem's boombox, calling it 'jungle music' and telling them to turn it off, escalating the racial tension in the pizzeria.

entities.name: Ahmad, Cee, Punchy, and Ella begin dancing to the music
entities.description: Despite the tension, Ahmad, Cee, Punchy, and Ella start dancing to the loud rap music while Mookie sits and observes the unfolding conflict without intervening.

entities.name: Radio Raheem defiantly asserts his music as valid expression
entities.description: When Sal criticizes his music, Radio Raheem responds by declaring that it is his music and that it is legitimate, standing firm in his cultural identity.

entities.name: Vito declares the pizzeria closed to end the confrontation
entities.description: Vito attempts to de-escalate the situation by stating that the pizzeria is officially closed, signaling that no further business or interaction should occur.

entities.name: Buggin' Out declares the pizzeria closed until Black representation is added
entities.description: Buggin' Out retorts that the pizzeria is truly closed until Sal includes Black people on the Wall of Fame, framing the issue as a matter of racial justice and dignity.

entities.name: Closing Shift At Sal'S Famous Pizzeria
entities.description: The end-of-day closing procedure at Sal's Famous Pizzeria, involving final transactions, employee pay, and preparation to shut down, which becomes the setting for escalating social and racial tensions.
entities.summary: The end-of-day closing procedure at Sal's Famous Pizzeria, involving final transactions, employee pay, and preparation to shut down, which becomes the setting for escalating social and racial tensions.

entities.name: quitting time
entities.description: A specific time reference indicating the end of the workday, used to anchor when Mookie requests his pay.

entities.name: Sal'S Famous Pizzeria
entities.description: A named pizzeria that serves as the primary setting for the scene and the events taking place within it.
entities.summary: A named pizzeria serves as the primary setting for the scene, central to the conversation, events, and a focal point of the boycott, located near the radio station and referenced as Mookie's delivery origin.

entities.name: Vito
entities.description: An employee at Sal's Famous Pizzeria who is involved in cleaning up at closing time and reacts with horror at the idea of inheriting the pizzeria.
entities.summary: Sal's 20-year-old son works at the pizzeria, resents Pino's delegation, helps calm confrontations, offers to supervise Mookie on deliveries, avoids physical conflict with Pino, and accompanies Mookie to the radio station during a broadcast.

entities.name: Pino
entities.description: An employee at Sal's Famous Pizzeria who reacts with horror at the idea of inheriting the pizzeria and later confronts Radio Raheem.
entities.summary: Sal's son works at the pizzeria, often deflecting tasks to his brother Vito, whom he has physically abused. He confronts Mookie about tardiness and Buggin' Out over conflicts, asserts authority, and pressures staff amid rising tensions.

entities.name: Mookie
entities.description: An employee at Sal's Famous Pizzeria who requests his pay at quitting time and warns customers to leave promptly after receiving their food.
entities.summary: A young man arranges money, interacts with neighbors, delivers pizzas late, and faces conflict at Sal's pizzeria, while Jade's brother touches her in her sleep before leaving for work.

entities.name: Sal
entities.description: The owner of Sal's Famous Pizzeria who reflects on the success of the family-run business and confronts Buggin' Out and Radio Raheem about noise and representation.
entities.summary: The owner of Sal's Famous Pizzeria, a father of three sons including Pino and Vito, manages the business, interacts with customers, maintains order, and plays a central role in the community.

entities.name: Buggin' Out
entities.description: A customer who enters the pizzeria with Radio Raheem, challenges Sal about the lack of Black representation on the Wall of Fame, and declares the pizzeria closed until change occurs.
entities.summary: A neighborhood resident and regular at Sal's pizzeria, he is a b-boy who challenges racial representation on the Wall of Fame, confronts gentrification, and leads a boycott against the pizzeria, reflecting broader tensions over identity and belonging.

entities.name: Radio Raheem
entities.description: A customer who enters the pizzeria with a loud boombox, defies Sal's demands to turn off the music, and asserts his music as valid expression.
entities.summary: A tall, confident man carries a boombox, playing loud rap music as he moves through the neighborhood, asserting his presence, exchanging gestures with residents, and sharing a philosophy on love and hate, symbolized by his brass knuckles rings.

entities.name: Ahmad
entities.description: A customer who enters the pizzeria with friends to buy slices and agrees to leave promptly after receiving food.
entities.summary: A young man participates in neighborhood events, offering blunt advice, turning on a hydrant, joining a crowd during a confrontation, passing by during an emergency, sitting silently on a fire escape, and mocking a boycott proposal.

entities.name: Cee
entities.description: A customer who enters the pizzeria with friends to buy slices and begins dancing to the music played by Radio Raheem.

entities.name: Punchy
entities.description: A customer who enters the pizzeria with friends to buy slices and begins dancing to the music played by Radio Raheem.
entities.summary: A group member suggests Ella call Ahmad, plays pranks with a modified beer can, evades Charlie after soaking him, laughs at chaos from a rooftop with Cee, joins the crowd during Buggin' Out's confrontation, and is seen passing Eddie with Ahmad, Cee, and Ella.

entities.name: Ella
entities.description: A customer who enters the pizzeria with friends to buy slices and begins dancing to the music played by Radio Raheem.
entities.summary: A young woman interacts with Ahmad and others in various scenes, participates in community moments, resists being soaked, avoids confrontation, and joins in mocking Buggin' Out after his boycott fails.

entities.name: Boom Box
entities.description: A portable music player used by Radio Raheem to play loud rap music inside the pizzeria, becoming a focal point of conflict.
entities.summary: A portable stereo carried by Radio Raheem that plays loud rap music, particularly Public Enemy tapes, central to his identity and a focal point of conflict, especially in the pizzeria.

entities.description: A display in Sal's Famous Pizzeria featuring portraits of famous Italians, which becomes a point of contention due to the lack of Black representation.
entities.summary: A display of Italian-American figures at Sal's Famous Pizzeria sparks controversy over the lack of Black representation.

entities.name: Sal smashes Radio Raheem's boom box with a baseball bat
entities.description: Sal retrieves his Mickey Mantle bat and violently strikes Radio Raheem's boom box multiple times, destroying it and abruptly ending the music.

entities.description: After Sal destroys the boom box, everyone in the pizzeria freezes in shock, creating a sudden and tense quiet in the space.

entities.description: The interior setting where Sal destroys Radio Raheem's boom box and where an eerie silence follows.

entities.name: Sal
entities.description: The owner of the pizzeria who uses a baseball bat to destroy Radio Raheem's boom box in a sudden act of violence.
entities.summary: The owner of Sal's Famous Pizzeria, a father of three sons including Pino and Vito, manages the business, interacts with customers, maintains order, and plays a central role in the community.

entities.name: Radio Raheem
entities.description: A regular customer at the pizzeria known for carrying his loud boom box, which becomes the target of Sal's violent outburst.
entities.summary: A tall, confident man carries a boombox, playing loud rap music as he moves through the neighborhood, asserting his presence, exchanging gestures with residents, and sharing a philosophy on love and hate, symbolized by his brass knuckles rings.

entities.name: Mickey Mantle bat
entities.description: A baseball bat kept under the counter by Sal, used to destroy Radio Raheem's boom box.

entities.name: boom box
entities.description: Radio Raheem's prized possession that plays loud music, destroyed by Sal with a baseball bat.

entities.name: Radio Raheem attacks Sal by choking him after boom box destruction
entities.description: Enraged by the destruction of his boom box, Radio Raheem picks Sal up from behind the counter and begins choking him, escalating the confrontation violently.

entities.name: Vito and Pino intervene to stop Radio Raheem's chokehold
entities.description: Vito and Pino rush to subdue Radio Raheem as he continues to choke Sal, physically attacking him in an attempt to break his grip.

entities.name: Buggin' Out attempts to assist Radio Raheem during the struggle
entities.description: Buggin' Out joins the physical confrontation in support of Radio Raheem, trying to help him overpower Sal and the others.

entities.name: Mookie observes the violent struggle without intervening
entities.description: Mookie remains passive and watches the escalating fight between Radio Raheem, Sal, Vito, Pino, and Buggin' Out without taking action.

entities.name: Ahmad, Cee, Punchy, and Ella react to the struggle with encouragement
entities.description: Ahmad, Cee, Punchy, and Ella act as onlookers who cheer and react to the physical confrontation, heightening the tension in the pizzeria.

entities.name: Vito
entities.description: A participant who intervenes in the physical struggle to stop Radio Raheem from choking Sal.
entities.summary: Sal's 20-year-old son works at the pizzeria, resents Pino's delegation, helps calm confrontations, offers to supervise Mookie on deliveries, avoids physical conflict with Pino, and accompanies Mookie to the radio station during a broadcast.

entities.name: Pino
entities.description: A participant who intervenes in the physical struggle to stop Radio Raheem from choking Sal.
entities.summary: Sal's son works at the pizzeria, often deflecting tasks to his brother Vito, whom he has physically abused. He confronts Mookie about tardiness and Buggin' Out over conflicts, asserts authority, and pressures staff amid rising tensions.

entities.name: Buggin' Out
entities.description: A man who attempts to assist Radio Raheem during the struggle with Sal.
entities.summary: A neighborhood resident and regular at Sal's pizzeria, he is a b-boy who challenges racial representation on the Wall of Fame, confronts gentrification, and leads a boycott against the pizzeria, reflecting broader tensions over identity and belonging.

entities.name: Mookie
entities.description: A man who observes the violent struggle between Radio Raheem and Sal without intervening.
entities.summary: A young man arranges money, interacts with neighbors, delivers pizzas late, and faces conflict at Sal's pizzeria, while Jade's brother touches her in her sleep before leaving for work.

entities.name: Ahmad
entities.description: One of the onlookers who reacts to the struggle with encouragement.
entities.summary: A young man participates in neighborhood events, offering blunt advice, turning on a hydrant, joining a crowd during a confrontation, passing by during an emergency, sitting silently on a fire escape, and mocking a boycott proposal.

entities.name: Cee
entities.description: One of the onlookers who reacts to the struggle with encouragement.

entities.name: Punchy
entities.description: One of the onlookers who reacts to the struggle with encouragement.
entities.summary: A group member suggests Ella call Ahmad, plays pranks with a modified beer can, evades Charlie after soaking him, laughs at chaos from a rooftop with Cee, joins the crowd during Buggin' Out's confrontation, and is seen passing Eddie with Ahmad, Cee, and Ella.

entities.name: Ella
entities.description: One of the onlookers who reacts to the struggle with encouragement.
entities.summary: A young woman interacts with Ahmad and others in various scenes, participates in community moments, resists being soaked, avoids confrontation, and joins in mocking Buggin' Out after his boycott fails.

entities.name: materialism
entities.description: An ideological critique presented in the narrative regarding the misplaced value placed on possessions, exemplified by Radio Raheem's attachment to his boom box.

entities.name: misplaced sense of values
entities.description: A thematic concept describing the emotional and psychological vulnerability of individuals like Radio Raheem who derive self-worth from material objects.

document_metadata.title: 81、EXT: SAL'S FAMOUS PIZZERIA--NIGHT
document_metadata.summary: Mookie throws a garbage can through Sal's pizzeria window, igniting widespread violence as Da Mayor saves Sal and his sons from the mob.

entities.name: Radio Raheem, Buggin' Out, Sal, Vito, and Pino erupt into a violent physical struggle on the sidewalk
entities.description: A chaotic fight breaks out involving Radio Raheem, Buggin' Out, Sal, Vito, and Pino, who are entangled and rolling on the sidewalk outside Sal's Famous Pizzeria, drawing a crowd of onlookers.

entities.name: Da Mayor calls for the fight to stop
entities.description: Da Mayor observes the escalating fight and urges the participants to break it up, recognizing the danger but choosing not to physically intervene.

entities.name: Police arrive at the scene with sirens and weapons drawn
entities.description: Cops arrive in patrol cars, driving aggressively through the crowd, and exit their vehicles with nightsticks and guns, preparing to intervene in the conflict.

entities.name: Officers forcibly separate the fighters, targeting Radio Raheem most aggressively
entities.description: The police pull Buggin' Out, Vito, and Pino off the pile, but use overwhelming force to subdue Radio Raheem, requiring six officers to restrain him.

entities.name: Radio Raheem is placed in a choke hold and becomes unresponsive
entities.description: After being restrained with a choke hold, Radio Raheem stops struggling, his body goes limp, and he collapses unconscious to the sidewalk.

entities.name: Officers Long and Ponte kick Radio Raheem's unconscious body
entities.description: Despite Radio Raheem being motionless, Officers Long and Ponte kick him and demand he get up, accusing him of faking unconsciousness.

entities.name: Crowd witnesses Radio Raheem's lifeless body in shock and silence
entities.description: The onlookers stare in horror at Radio Raheem's still form, realizing the severity of the police's actions and the possibility that he is dead.

entities.name: Police throw Radio Raheem's body into a patrol car and leave the scene
entities.description: The officers lift Radio Raheem's limp body and toss it into the back seat of a police car, then speed away, leaving the stunned crowd behind.

entities.name: Buggin' Out is handcuffed and placed in a police car
entities.description: After being pulled from the fight, Buggin' Out is restrained with handcuffs and forced into a patrol car while watching Radio Raheem being subdued.

entities.name: Sal'S Famous Pizzeria
entities.description: A named pizzeria that serves as the central location where the confrontation and subsequent events unfold.
entities.summary: A named pizzeria serves as the primary setting for the scene, central to the conversation, events, and a focal point of the boycott, located near the radio station and referenced as Mookie's delivery origin.

entities.summary: The Block, an urban neighborhood centered around Sal's Famous Pizzeria, serves as the primary setting where community members gather and the film's events unfold.

entities.summary: An elderly woman observes the neighborhood from her window, offering care and warnings, unimpressed by Da Mayor's advances, sharing stories, and silently acknowledging his heroic act.

entities.summary: A regular member of the group of men who gather on the corner, engaging in philosophical discussions, interacting humorously with others, opposing Buggin' Out's boycott, and participating in community moments during conflicts.

entities.summary: An older man sweeps for money to buy alcohol, visits a deli, searches for his preferred beer, drinks on the sidewalk, interacts with Mother Sister, and advises Mookie while sitting on a stoop.

entities.name: Officer Long
entities.description: A police officer who participates in subduing Radio Raheem, applies a choke hold, and later kicks his unconscious body.
entities.summary: A police officer responds to a scene involving Charlie, uses a racial slur against a Puerto Rican individual, interacts with Sal at a pizzeria, and participates in subduing Radio Raheem with a choke hold before kicking his unconscious body.

entities.summary:

entities.description: With the police gone and Sal's group left defenseless, the mob turns its anger toward Sal, Vito, and Pino, glaring at them as symbols of vulnerability and potential retribution.

entities.name: Mob members voice accusations of systemic police murder
entities.description: Members of the mob shout condemnations, linking Radio Raheem's death to prior killings of Black individuals like Michael Stewart and Eleanor Bumpers, framing it as a pattern of state violence.
